title: IN AGENTS WE TRUST, BUT WHO DO AGENTS TRUST? LATENT SOURCE PREFERENCES STEER LLM GENERATIONS

bias_targets.methodology: Directly asking models to rank information sources (e.g., news outlets, academic venues, e-commerce platforms) and indirectly evaluating preferences by having models choose between semantically identical content attributed to different sources.

Analyzing model selections of news articles from left-, center-, and right-leaning outlets, including experimental conditions where source labels are hidden or swapped between articles to isolate the effect of source preference on perceived political slant.

Evaluating model preferences for news sources and e-commerce platforms originating from different countries and geographic regions (e.g., United States, Europe, China) using direct and indirect selection tasks.
